name: The staircase of horror
hint: The everyday cracks, step by step, until nothing is safe and the fear shows what it is really about.

parts.title: The everyday
chapters: The place and the people
Show ordinary life, what the main character wants and stands to lose, and their private fear, with a first omen on page one.
The first strange thing
A small thing that does not add up and can be explained away: the reader should sense more than the main character does.
The explanations
Everyone, the main character included, finds a reasonable explanation. A reason to stay makes leaving hard.

parts.title: It grows
chapters: The pattern
The events repeat and follow something like rules. Show one rule in action without explaining it.
Closer
The threat gets into what ought to be safe: the home, the bed, the body or someone close.
No one believes
The main character asks for help and is dismissed. Being alone becomes a threat in itself.
The first price
Someone is hurt, vanishes or dies. From now on the reader knows that anyone can be next.

parts.title: The truth
chapters: The false calm
After the loss it seems possible to live with. Grief, closeness and a plan give the reader room to breathe, which is exactly why the next step hits harder.
What happened here
The main character learns where the threat comes from and what it wants. The truth should make things worse, not easier.
The escape that fails
An attempt to get away or stop the threat goes wrong and reveals a rule nobody knew.
Cut off
The ways out close: the car, the phone, the friends. The main character faces their private fear head on.

parts.title: The worst
chapters: The descent
The main character chooses to go where they least want to, the cellar, the woods or the memory, because it is the only way.
The confrontation
The threat is met on its own terms, and the rules set up earlier decide the outcome, not luck.
The echo
What survived and what did not. Leave one last unease that follows the reader out of the book.
